item.mng: čoγtu včir ǰirüken čimeg-ün dandr-a kemegdekü
item.coloph: čoγtu včir ǰirüken čimeg-ün dandr-a ene yeke bisilgal-un mön činar maγadduγsan neretü čoγtu odiyan-a niγuča-yin aqlaγ-ača boluγsan tegüsbe, enedkeg-ün ubadini kamala gubta kiged, töbed-ün yeke kelemürči mnah bdag lha ye ses rgyal mčhan ber orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu nutalan baγulγabai

item.mng: čoγ-tu včir-un / jirüken-ü čimeg neretü dandir-a,
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini / kala la gubta kiged, töbed-ün yeke kelemürči ayimaγ-un eǰen yeke tngri belge bilig ilaγuγsan / čimeg orčiγulǰu nayiraγulun orosiγulbai, ,
item.colophTitle: čoγ-tu / uḍi yaa na-yin niγuča-yin süm-e keyid-eče γaruγsan tegüsbei.
item.note: čoγ-tu / uḍi yaa na niγuča-yin süm-e keyid-eče γaruγsan tegüsbei:: - This part of the text is represented in Kasyanenkovas catalogue as part of the col. Though it looks more like a final title of the bigger text unifying the previous and this one. Compare with the col. of the tibetan text.
